reeval.finding: Host settings responses omit global/named-provider API-key values and MCP command/URL/argument/environment/header values. Model keys and MCP command/URL/args/env/header entries have reference/existence DTOs and separate query/replace/delete host commands. The form sends metadata, deletions and replacements in one host batch; an invalid later operation leaves the existing settings file unchanged, and successful batches persist encrypted secrets with metadata in one file replacement. Settings IPC writes, app_control settings/instruction writes and settings rollback share an in-process mutex across load-modify-save. The host rejects inline secret submission. Source-level env/header editors retain partial input. Kernel settings format v2 encrypts MCP values on save; a v1 plaintext fixture migrates on next save and rejects corrupted v2 ciphertext. New app_control rollback snapshots encrypt their before-image and bind a change ID; historical plaintext snapshots remain readable. A filesystem fixture restored a historical plaintext MCP snapshot into encrypted format-v2 settings and rejected malformed rollback input without a file write. Kernel settings tests 11/11, desktop secret tests 7/7, app_changes tests 4/4, app_control projection test 1/1, frontend typecheck and focused Vitest passed on Windows. Cross-process writes, existing v1 files/backups and old plaintext snapshots, native UI/rollback confirmation and complete outlet scan remain open. Connector credential mutations now reject unreadable or malformed existing credential files instead of overwriting them; a corruption fixture passed 1/1 on Windows. Plaintext storage, tolerant read paths and native recovery remain open. Connector credential read/enable paths now surface malformed storage errors; credential DTO projection always masks OAuth access/refresh tokens even when not declared as manifest secret fields. A synthetic token marker test passed 1/1 on Windows. Full credential-key and outlet inventory remains open. Connector credential projection now defaults to masking undeclared fields, reveals only declared nonsecret fields and expiry metadata, and overrides incorrect public declarations for OAuth tokens. Focused synthetic fixture passed 1/1 on Windows. IM settings DTO now masks Slack, Discord, Teams and outbound webhook URLs, and save retains old values on masked placeholders; synthetic marker projection fixture passed 1/1 on Windows. Explicit deletion and native behavior remain open. Connector credential editor now surfaces host read/decode errors rather than silently showing an empty form; frontend typecheck passed on Windows. Diagnostic export now redacts four token-bearing webhook URL settings, aligned with IM DTO masking; synthetic fixture passed 1/1 on Windows. Full outlet and native verification remain open. Diagnostic redaction also covers settings URL fields generically, including custom model base URL; revised focused fixture passed 1/1. Form display contract is unchanged.

Windows-only Rust 集成探针真实创建零 capability AppContainer 并启动 cmd.exe，用户 Temp canary 读取被 OS 拒绝（1/1）。该探针仍仅为测试证据，未接 AgentZ code_run/shell。

Windows-only test now verifies AppContainer child reads/writes only the granted temp workspace, refuses sibling file access, and cannot connect to host-local loopback without network capability; 1/1 passed, 4.52s. Still test-only; no tool integration.

探针进程改为 CREATE_SUSPENDED，关联 kill-on-close Job Object 后再 ResumeThread；Windows AppContainer positive/negative cases 1/1 passed, 4.79s test (2m54s build). Production integration and descendant-expiry assertion remain pending.

Added a Windows regression: root command spawns delayed child and exits; Job Object reports remaining descendant; closing kill-on-close Job prevents delayed marker. Test 1/1 passed, 10.34s. Still #[cfg(test)], no production code_run/shell integration.

Extracted Windows workspace ACL changes into reusable WorkspaceAclLease; AppContainer test now exercises the shared lease and asserts parent/root/existing-file DACL byte-for-byte restoration, while verifying newly created files are cleaned of temporary SID. Windows probe 1/1 passed, 10.32s; still not called by code_run/shell.
生产 AppContainer runner 已接入 code_run 与 shell；验证跨入口越界文件拒绝、目录内访问、loopback 网络拒绝、hard-link 拒绝、取消超时收割和工具目录能力披露。内核全量测试、Clippy 与 Windows Tauri 定向测试通过；Linux target 因缺少 core 未编译，不计通过。
增补复核发现：静态 reparse/hard-link 拒绝通过，但 ACL 仍按路径名读取/改写；同宿主并发替换的 TOCTOU 尚未解决且未实测，保持doing并优先研究句柄绑定与确定性竞态夹具。

修复ACL恢复时DACL继承保护位丢失；新增null-DACL授予失败回滚注入，内核全量345通过并复核Clippy/rustfmt
生产ACL读取/授予/恢复改用已打开对象句柄；no-follow最终分量及确定性路径替换测试证明替换路径未被误改。ancestor链和对象移出workspace竞态仍开放，故不关闭任务
Windows runner 现从保留目录句柄枚举子项并用 NtCreateFile 相对 no-follow 打开；替换路径夹具与全量串行测试通过，仍未约束根 parent 绑定及对象移出/并发新增生命周期，保持 doing。
从本地卷根逐段句柄相对打开 canonical workspace parent，拒绝每级 reparse；修复 ACL cleanup active 状态反转，失败保持可重试、成功关闭。新增 ancestor 替换与 cleanup 失败回调夹具；Windows 内核全测串行 349/0/1 ignored，pool 25 passed，clippy/rustfmt 通过。

canonical workspace parent 已从卷根逐段句柄相对 no-follow 解析并保留祖先句柄，拒绝路径链 reparse；修复 ACL lease active 状态反转。新增 ancestor 替换验证与真实 SetSecurityInfo Access Denied/恢复重试测试；内核串行全测349/0/1 ignored、pool 25、clippy/rustfmt 通过。

从卷根逐段句柄相对 no-follow 解析 canonical workspace parent，拒绝每级 reparse 并保留祖先句柄；workspace root 使用无 delete-sharing 句柄防止租约期间移动。修复 ACL lease active 状态反转，加入真实 SetSecurityInfo Access Denied 后恢复重试测试；串行全测350/0/1 ignored，pool 25，clippy/rustfmt通过。
workspace lease 失败注入扩展到多对象：root DACL 恢复成功后对子文件实际 SetSecurityInfo Access Denied，确认继续清理、返回错误且保留 active lease；替换句柄重试后全部恢复。现有串行全量350/0/1 ignored，目标故障夹具复跑通过。
补齐越界移动与祖先锁定边界的Windows实测：AppContainer无法把文件移至sibling；workspace root、直接parent及选定higher ancestor在保留句柄期间不能重命名。全量串行351/0/1 ignored，pool 25，Clippy/rustfmt/diff-check通过。宿主侧并发新增/删除/移出策略及更高目录层级仍待验证，维持doing。

加入cfg(test)枚举后注入点，生产finish路径仅经内部finish_inner传入no-op；精确在cleanup扫描后创建并同卷移出文件，确认租约恢复后临时SID已清除。内核串行全测353/0/1 ignored，pool25通过。支持披露已核对；原生GUI按用户指示跳过并保持未验证。转入review自检。
去掉自动生成后重复句末标点。
